cases.sql: CREATE TYPE cw_tuple AS(a bigint,b integer,c smallint,d boolean,e integer); PREPARE cw_whole AS SELECT '(72623859790382856,287454020,21862,t,2005440938)'::cw_tuple AS v; PREPARE cw_null AS SELECT '(,287454020,21862,t,2005440938)'::cw_tuple AS v; PREPARE cw_bitmap AS SELECT '(,287454020,21862,t,2005440938)'::cw_tuple IS NULL AS n, '(,287454020,21862,t,2005440938)'::cw_tuple IS NOT NULL AS nn; EXECUTE cw_whole; EXECUTE cw_null; EXECUTE cw_bitmap
BEGIN; ALTER TYPE cw_tuple ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE integer; EXECUTE cw_whole; EXECUTE cw_null; EXECUTE cw_bitmap
ALTER TYPE cw_tuple ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE smallint; EXECUTE cw_whole; EXECUTE cw_null
ALTER TYPE cw_tuple ALTER ATTRIBUTE b TYPE smallint; EXECUTE cw_whole; EXECUTE cw_null
ALTER TYPE cw_tuple DROP ATTRIBUTE a; EXECUTE cw_whole; EXECUTE cw_null
ALTER TYPE cw_tuple ADD ATTRIBUTE x bigint; EXECUTE cw_whole; EXECUTE cw_null; EXECUTE cw_bitmap
ROLLBACK; EXECUTE cw_whole; EXECUTE cw_null; EXECUTE cw_bitmap
CREATE VIEW cw_view AS SELECT '(72623859790382856,287454020,21862,t,2005440938)'::cw_tuple AS v; ALTER TYPE cw_tuple ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE integer; SELECT * FROM cw_view
ALTER TYPE cw_tuple ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE smallint; SELECT * FROM cw_view
ALTER TYPE cw_tuple ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bigint; SELECT * FROM cw_view
CREATE TYPE cw_wide AS(a integer,b integer,c bigint); PREPARE cw_widen AS SELECT '(16909060,84281096,72623859790382856)'::cw_wide AS v; EXECUTE cw_widen
ALTER TYPE cw_wide ALTER ATTRIBUTE a TYPE bigint; ALTER TYPE cw_wide DROP ATTRIBUTE c; EXECUTE cw_widen

CREATE TYPE cw_empty AS(a integer,b integer); PREPARE cw_mixed AS SELECT '(1,)'::cw_empty IS NULL AS n, '(1,)'::cw_empty IS NOT NULL AS nn; EXECUTE cw_mixed; ALTER TYPE cw_empty DROP ATTRIBUTE b; EXECUTE cw_mixed; ALTER TYPE cw_empty ADD ATTRIBUTE c text; EXECUTE cw_mixed
